title: The classification of endpoint-transitive graphs with geodesic condition
summary: We introduce endpoint k-path-transitive graphs, in which the automorphism group fixing two prescribed vertices pointwise acts transitively on the paths of length k joining them. We study the geodesic case, where k equals the distance between these vertices. We identify the union of these geodesics with the Hasse graph of a finite bounded graded poset and reduce it to proper blocks by complete cuts andmatching compression.
